item.title: Audio Logo Design
item.description: My take on re-creating Prism Entertainment’s sound logo. Designed with soft synths and processing, aiming to match the original as closely as possible.

item.title: Droemmefanger
item.description: Through live sound processing Droemmefanger captures and manipulates the real world sounds in real-time. This is done through live processing where recorded sounds is processed and replayed randomly and according to some specific rules which is defined in the code.

item.title: Elemental Design
item.description:
I did this design to explore the more stylized sound of elemental magic and electricity. Created with layered and processed recordings of crackling cardstock, cellophane and a chips bag + some synthesis with Phaseplant.

Animation Artist: Deeamo Julien

item.title: Explosion Design
item.description: Took small firework recordings and processed them into large, low-end explosions. Watch the video to hear the before and after.

item.title: Game Audio Implementation
item.description: As a student assignment, I was tasked with recording, designing and implementing all sounds for a demo game named The Giant’s Rest. Everything from the background ambience to the monsters screams is made by me. Made in Reaper, and implemented into Unity game engine with the middleware Wwise.

item.title: Lydro
item.description:
Lydro is an XR-based spatialized sound experience, which utilizes the 3dof head tracking technology available in modern headphone devices. It is a fully interactive experience, where the user can explore the environment and interact with the soundscape.

The app was conceptualized as part of a larger research project on Aarhus University in 2023, in collaboration with the VR company AATE VR. The whole experience was designed and developed by me.
